items.title: Vi Redd interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 13, 1999
items.q: that union over there on Central Avenue, and I worked in it briefly when I was in college with Florence Kadries.

ctx.x: Some people, it seems like I’ve read that that wasn’t a positive thing for everyone concerned.

At the time there was quite a bit of confusion about it. Many of the black musicians kind of got lost in the — that union over there on Central Avenue, and I worked in it briefly when I was in college with Florence Kadries. Oh gosh, now you don’t have enough time for me to go there.
